payload.prompt: Create a clear image with exactly ten separate objects total: exactly four individual trumpets, exactly two individual brown trucks, and exactly four individual toys. Show the four toys as four separate toys that are not trucks and not trumpets, fully visible and not touching or overlapping. Show the four trumpets as four separate trumpets. Do not include any extra trumpets, trucks, or toys, and do not hide, merge, crop, or partially obscure any object.
